name: Alchemists
summary: Deduction game where alchemists mix ingredients, test potions via app, publish theories and sell potions for reputation and points.
rules_text: The app secretly assigns each of 8 ingredients a unique alchemical composed of three colors. Over 6 rounds players act. First choose turn order by picking spaces that give ingredients and favors, sometimes paying gold; lowest chooser declares actions first but acts last. Then place action cubes on spaces to forage, transmute, mix two ingredients and scan them with the app to learn potion result, sell potion to an adventurer, buy artifact, publish or debunk theory, gain grants. Results of your mixes stay private behind screens; public info is published theories, gold, artifacts, potion history. Publishing earns reputation if correct later, loses if wrong. After round 6, reputation converts to points plus artifacts and grants. Most points wins.
